claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified for launch on the present record despite a current aviation maintenance triage regression, because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and certification can rely on documenting the limitation and monitoring deployment risk.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases are disclosed before launch or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness pass and absence of severity-one incidents are supportive but not sufficient when a separate disclosure predicate remains unresolved.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring comments may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
evidence_requests: Produce the current release documentation or model card showing the aviation maintenance triage regression and current evaluation results are disclosed for this release.
Produce an approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation tied to the maintenance triage weakness if disclosure is not already complete.
Produce the release decision artifact showing certification was made against the current retrieval configuration and current eval batch rather than relying on the prior approval.
specific_concerns: The policy predicate for certification is not satisfied by the current record unless current release documentation already reflects the current evaluation results and discloses the material segment weakness, and no such documentation is in evidence.

The aviation maintenance triage slice is a named launch use case with a current 1.1 percentage point regression below the warning threshold, which makes the limitation material under the cited policy.
The informal post-launch monitoring comment is not a reviewed mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or attached disclosure language.
Prior approval of the same model family is explicitly stale relative to the current retrieval configuration change and current evaluation batch, so it cannot carry the current certification decision.
Public governance guidance supports documentation and monitoring in general, but it does not prove that the required current release documentation or approved mitigation exists in this case.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the present record.
That the current model card or release documentation has already been updated to reflect the current evaluation results and the maintenance triage weakness.
That ongoing monitoring, without reviewed mitigation or approved risk acceptance, is sufficient to satisfy the policy requirement for this material limitation.
